name: Savage Critical (3rd Party – Kobold Press)
body:
Sometimes your attacks are much more effective than others.

Benefit: If you roll a natural 20 on an attack roll and confirm a critical (or you otherwise confirm a critical hit), treat your weapon’s critical multiplier as if it were 1 point higher.

Advanced Feats: Visions of the Oracle. Author: Sigfried Trent Copyright 2011, Open Design LLC, www.koboldquarterly.com. All rights reserved.
